name: Analyze Fatty Acid Composition By Gc
description: Analyzes fatty acid composition in tissue samples using gas chromatography data.
detailed_description: Analyzes fatty acid composition in tissue samples using gas chromatography data.
when_to_use: When you need analyze fatty acid composition by gc analysis

parameters.gc_data_file: [Required] Path to the CSV file containing gas chromatography data with columns 'retention_time' and 'peak_area' (str)
parameters.tissue_type: [Required] Type of tissue sample (e.g., liver, kidney, heart, muscle, adipose) (str)
parameters.sample_id: [Required] Identifier for the sample being analyzed (str)
parameters.output_directory: [Optional] Directory where result files will be saved (default: ./results)
